changelog:
- Updated output format: strategic analysis now split into four explicit sections (Macro — Industry & Market, Middle — Product & Customer, Micro — Team & Founders, Micro — Economics & Cash) plus a single-sentence Strategic Implication, instead of "Where to Play / How to Win / What's the Risk".
- No code changes; documentation and guidance only.
- Analysis framework in description and instructions updated to match revised structured output.
- All usage, prompt, and example text still reference the original execution flow.
summary: Scrapes public data to deliver a structured strategic analysis of a company using the HBS & TikTok Where to Play / How to Win / What's the Risk framework.
